note: Global site header -- renders: Booking.com logo, language/currency selectors, sign-in controls, and fixed navigation tabs (Accommodations/Flights/Packages/Cars/Attractions/Airport taxis)
Breadcrumb navigation -- renders: fixed navigation hierarchy (Home/Accommodations/Region/City/Property)
Property detail tabs -- renders: fixed section labels (Overview/Availability/Facilities/Policies/Fine print/Reviews)
Booking action bar -- renders: fixed controls (Add to wishlist, Share, Book now, Price guarantee)
Property header controls -- renders: fixed action buttons (Map, Directions, Save)
Map widget controls -- renders: fixed labels (Map, Directions)

Availability section chrome -- renders: fixed labels (Availability, Price guarantee, Search controls); subtracts the room availability table which contains seller-defined room names, descriptions, and prices
Facilities section -- renders: fixed section labels and facility names (e.g., Free WiFi, Parking, Pool) defined by the platform's taxonomy
User survey widget -- renders: fixed platform-authored survey questions and answer options
Policies section -- renders: fixed policy labels and platform-standard policy text (Check-in, Check-out, Children, Pets, etc.)
Important information section -- renders: fixed platform-authored legal and informational text
FAQ section -- renders: fixed platform-authored frequently asked questions and answers
Site footer -- renders: fixed navigation links, legal links, and language/currency controls
